spec_family.name: Exterior Porch & Patio Floor Coating
spec_family.description: Combined prime and finish coat painting/coating for exterior porch floor and patio surfaces. Dual-substrate spec covering concrete and wood porch floors. Concrete substrates support four coating systems (porch enamel, acrylic sealer, concrete stain, polyurea); wood substrates support porch enamel only. Coating system replaces quality tier as primary configuration dimension. Covers full prep (moisture testing, acid etch or diamond grind for concrete, sanding for wood, crack fill, cleaning), substrate-appropriate primer (alkali-resistant masonry for concrete, exterior wood primer, polyurea manufacturer primer, moisture-mitigating contingency), finish coat application (roll/brush_roll/spray_backroll), mandatory anti-slip aggregate broadcast, and sealer topcoat for concrete stain system. Uses SF as primary UOM. Epoxy excluded from v1. No height modifier — ground-level work. Anti-slip aggregate is mandatory for ALL coating systems on exterior horizontal surfaces.

includes: Moisture testing — ASTM D4263 for concrete (mandatory scheduling item), pin-type MC meter for wood
Concrete surface profiling — acid etch (muriatic acid + neutralizer) or diamond grind (polyurea requires CSP 3-5)
Concrete crack fill and patching (hairline to 1/4 inch cracks)
Wood mill glaze removal and sanding (60-80 grit)
Substrate-appropriate primer application (alkali-resistant masonry, exterior wood, polyurea manufacturer, or moisture-mitigating)
Finish coat application — porch enamel, acrylic sealer, concrete stain, or polyurea topcoat per coating_system dimension
Sealer topcoat for concrete stain system (clear acrylic over stain)
Anti-slip aggregate broadcast — mandatory for all coating systems (silica sand standard, aluminum oxide premium)
Step detail work when has_steps = true (tread/riser coating, nosing detail)

excludes.route_to: Excluded from v1 per KD-001 — specialist scope, not standard residential painting

excludes.item: Structural concrete repair (cracks > 1/4 inch or actively moving)
Wood deck staining (horizontal wood with transparent/semi-transparent stain)
excludes.route_to: SF_DECK_EXT_v1 — deck staining is a separate spec family

excludes.item: Interior porch floor (screened-in porch treated as interior)

configuration_dimensions.description: Porch floor substrate type. Primary branch point driving prep module activation, primer selection, and coating system compatibility.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Concrete is ~80% of residential porches. Wood porches use tongue-and-groove or decking boards with porch enamel only. concrete_stain, acrylic_sealer, and polyurea are concrete-only systems. substrate_type drives completely different prep modules, primer systems, and failure mode profiles.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary configuration dimension — replaces quality_tier. Determines material selection, round configuration, production rates, and maintenance cycle.
configuration_dimensions.notes: porch_enamel: both substrates, traditional acrylic floor paint, 2 finish coats. concrete_stain: concrete only, penetrating decorative + sealer topcoat. acrylic_sealer: concrete only, self-priming breathable film, 2 coats. polyurea: concrete only, highest durability, manufacturer-specific primer, fast cure. Epoxy excluded per KD-001.

configuration_dimensions.description: Covered porch vs open patio. Drives environmental exposure modifier, drying time considerations, and maintenance cycle expectations.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Covered porch has partial protection from UV, rain, and direct sun — baseline condition. Open patio has full environmental exposure — 5% production modifier, shorter maintenance cycles.

configuration_dimensions.description: Boolean indicating porch has steps. Activates step prep and step detail tasks.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Step area is included in total porch floor SF. When true, activates MOD_PRFL_PREP_STEPS tasks and step-specific anti-slip aggregate broadcast. Step nosing detail requires brush work regardless of field application method.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for primer and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Roll is primary for floor coatings (3/8-3/4 nap, extension pole). brush_roll for detail areas, steps, edges, and wood plank porches. spray_backroll for large open patios (>400 SF). Spray-only is PROHIBITED — backroll mandatory on floor surfaces to ensure film integrity and anti-slip aggregate adhesion.

paintable_items.name: Exterior Porch Floor / Patio Floor Surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable porch or patio floor area in square feet. Includes step treads and risers when has_steps = true. Measured from PaintScope exterior survey.
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item. Covers both concrete and wood substrates via substrate_type dimension. Horizontal surface with foot traffic abrasion, water pooling, UV exposure, and mandatory slip resistance requirements.

valid_input_states.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY for new concrete porch floors (pH 12-14 alkaline). SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD for new wood porch floors. Both are NC input states. Dual-substrate spec — substrate_type dimension determines which state applies.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by coating system. Porch enamel and acrylic sealer produce satin finish. Concrete stain produces semi-transparent stained surface. Polyurea produces semi-gloss film.

material_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Masonry Primer for Concrete Porch Floor
material_systems.notes: Mandatory on bare concrete when coating_system = porch_enamel. pH 12-14 alkaline surface requires alkali-resistant primer. Coverage 200-300 SF/gal (lower on broom-finish concrete).

material_systems.name: Exterior Wood Primer for Wood Porch Floor
material_systems.notes: Required on bare wood porch floor when coating_system = porch_enamel. Seals grain, promotes adhesion. Coverage 350-400 SF/gal.

material_systems.name: Polyurea Manufacturer-Specific Basecoat/Primer
material_systems.notes: Must match topcoat manufacturer for adhesion warranty. Coverage 200-350 SF/gal. Requires diamond grind surface profile (CSP 3-5).

material_systems.name: Moisture-Mitigating Primer (Contingency)
material_systems.notes: Contingency product — used only when concrete fails ASTM D4263 moisture test. Scheduling item per KD-006. Coverage 200-300 SF/gal.

material_systems.name: Acrylic Porch & Floor Enamel
material_systems.notes: Heavy-duty acrylic floor enamel for foot traffic. Both substrates (concrete + wood). 2 finish coats standard. Coverage 350-450 SF/gal.

material_systems.name: Breathable Acrylic Sealer (Concrete Only)
material_systems.notes: Self-priming — no separate primer needed. Breathable film allows moisture vapor transmission. 2 coats standard. Coverage 200-350 SF/gal.

material_systems.name: Penetrating Concrete Stain (Concrete Only)
material_systems.notes: Penetrating decorative stain — acid-based (1 coat) or water-based (2 coats). Requires separate sealer topcoat. Coverage 200-400 SF/gal depending on porosity.

material_systems.name: Clear Acrylic Topcoat Sealer (For Concrete Stain)
material_systems.notes: Mandatory over concrete stain per KD-009. Clear acrylic topcoat provides wear protection and UV resistance. Anti-slip aggregate broadcast into this layer. Coverage 300-500 SF/gal.

material_systems.name: Polyurea/Polyaspartic Floor Coating (Concrete Only)
material_systems.notes: Highest durability, chemical resistance, UV stability. Fast cure (4-8 hr walk-on). Two-component system with pot life constraints (~20-30 min). Coverage 200-300 SF/gal.

modules.notes: Wall base, railing base, door threshold, landscape, hardscape protection
ASTM D4263 moisture test — mandatory scheduling item for concrete
Acid etch or diamond grind, crack fill, clean
Mill glaze removal, MC test, sand, clean
Alkali masonry primer (roll/spray_backroll), wood primer (roll/brush), polyurea primer, moisture-mitigating primer — conditional by substrate_type and coating_system
Porch enamel (roll/brush/spray_backroll), acrylic sealer (roll), concrete stain, polyurea (roll), step detail, sealer topcoat — conditional by coating_system and has_steps
Anti-slip aggregate broadcast — field and steps. Mandatory for all coating systems.
Remove protection, replace furniture, final inspection, cleanup

protection_zones_required.notes: LF-based — wall base perimeter where house wall meets porch floor. Tape and mask to prevent coating splash/overspray on siding or foundation wall.
LF-based — railing post bases where railing meets floor. Tape around post bases. Not all porches have railings.
EA-based — door threshold at porch entry point. Mask threshold to prevent coating encroachment. At least 1 entry door threshold always present.
LF-based — landscape beds adjacent to porch/patio edge. Drop cloth or tarp over plantings when spraying.
LF-based — adjacent walkway, driveway, or patio edge. Canvas drop cloth for non-slip crew traffic and overspray containment.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Net porch/patio floor area (square feet). Primary measurement for all coating and material calculations.
Porch floor substrate type (concrete/wood). Drives primer selection, prep module activation, and coating system compatibility.
Porch floor coating system (porch_enamel/concrete_stain/acrylic_sealer/polyurea). Primary configuration dimension.
Porch exposure type (covered_porch/open_patio). Drives environmental exposure modifier.
Boolean flag indicating porch has steps. Activates step prep and step detail tasks.
Count of porch steps (tread + riser = 1 step). Step area included in total porch floor SF.
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for this NC spec.
Linear feet of wall base perimeter adjacent to porch floor requiring masking protection.
Linear feet of railing base requiring masking protection.
Count of door thresholds requiring masking. At least 1 entry door always present.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When landscape is adjacent to porch/patio edge
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Linear feet of landscape perimeter adjacent to porch requiring protection.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When hardscape (walkway/driveway) is adjacent to porch edge
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Linear feet of adjacent hardscape edge requiring protection.

compatibility_rules.action: BLOCK — polyurea requires concrete substrate with diamond grind profile (CSP 3-5). Not compatible with wood.
BLOCK — concrete stain is a penetrating product formulated for concrete chemistry. Not compatible with wood.
BLOCK — acrylic sealer is formulated for concrete moisture vapor transmission. Not compatible with wood.

compatibility_rules.description: Porch enamel on concrete requires alkali-resistant masonry primer
compatibility_rules.action: REQUIRE SYS_EXT_PRFL_PRIMER_ALKALI_MASONRY — new concrete pH 12-14 causes saponification with standard primers.

compatibility_rules.description: Porch enamel on wood requires exterior wood primer
compatibility_rules.action: REQUIRE SYS_EXT_PRFL_PRIMER_WOOD_EXT — seals grain and promotes adhesion for film-forming floor paint.
REQUIRE SYS_EXT_PRFL_FINISH_SEALER_TOPCOAT — penetrating stain has no film build, sealer provides wear protection and locks in anti-slip aggregate.
REQUIRE SYS_EXT_PRFL_PRIMER_POLYUREA — must match topcoat manufacturer for adhesion warranty.

compatibility_rules.description: Anti-slip aggregate mandatory for all coating systems
compatibility_rules.action: REQUIRE anti-slip aggregate broadcast (silica sand or aluminum oxide). Safety requirement for all exterior horizontal surfaces subject to foot traffic and wet conditions.

compatibility_rules.description: Polyurea requires diamond grind surface profile
compatibility_rules.action: REQUIRE diamond grind prep (CSP 3-5). Acid etch is insufficient for polyurea adhesion.

compatibility_rules.description: Spray-only application prohibited on floor surfaces
compatibility_rules.action: BLOCK — spray-only prohibited. Backroll mandatory on floor surfaces to ensure film integrity, even coverage in texture valleys, and anti-slip aggregate adhesion. Use spray_backroll instead.

compatibility_rules.description: Hot surface temperature blocks all coating operations
compatibility_rules.action: BLOCK — floor coatings fail immediately on overheated surfaces (flash drying, bubbling, delamination). Concrete retains and radiates heat — surface temp can exceed air temp by 20-40F in direct sun. Schedule early morning or late afternoon work windows.

compatibility_rules.description: Epoxy coating systems excluded from v1
compatibility_rules.action: BLOCK — epoxy excluded per KD-001. Specialist scope requiring specific humidity/temperature control, multiple component mixing, and extended cure management beyond standard residential painting.

round_configurations.name: Concrete + Porch Enamel: Primer + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Standard concrete porch enamel sequence. Alkali-resistant primer mandatory. Two finish coats with interstage inspection. Anti-slip broadcast into final coat.

round_configurations.name: Concrete + Acrylic Sealer: 2 Sealer Coats (Self-Priming)
round_configurations.notes: Self-priming system — no separate primer coat. Two sealer coats. Fast dry, thin film. Anti-slip broadcast into final coat.

round_configurations.name: Concrete + Concrete Stain: 1-2 Stain + 1-2 Sealer Topcoat
round_configurations.notes: Penetrating stain (1-2 coats) + mandatory sealer topcoat (1-2 coats). Acid stain typically 1 coat, water-based 2 coats. Interstage inspection after stain to verify color uniformity before sealing. Anti-slip broadcast into sealer topcoat.

round_configurations.name: Concrete + Polyurea: Primer + 1-2 Topcoats
round_configurations.notes: Manufacturer-specific primer + basecoat (with anti-slip) + optional topcoat. Fast cure — full system can be applied in single day. No interstage inspection — fast cure windows require continuous application. Anti-slip broadcast into basecoat.

round_configurations.name: Wood + Porch Enamel: Primer + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Exterior wood primer + two coats porch enamel. Standard for wood plank porch floors. Interstage inspection between finish coats. Anti-slip broadcast into final coat.

variants.notes: Most common residential combination. Covered porch, concrete, porch enamel. Baseline conditions.
Open patio, concrete, porch enamel. 1.05x exposure modifier. Shorter maintenance cycle (3-5 yr vs 5-7 yr).
Covered porch, concrete, acrylic sealer. Self-priming, no primer coat. Natural concrete appearance.
Open patio, concrete, acrylic sealer. Shortest maintenance cycle (2-4 yr). Good for budget-conscious customers.
Covered porch, concrete, decorative stain + sealer. Requires sealer topcoat per COMPAT-PRFL-006.
Open patio, concrete stain. Full UV exposure on stain — sealer topcoat provides UV protection. Maintenance cycle 3-5 yr.
Covered porch, concrete, polyurea. Highest durability, longest maintenance cycle (7-10+ yr). Diamond grind prep required.
Open patio, concrete, polyurea. Full environmental exposure but highest chemical/UV resistance. Wind containment needed for spray operations.
Classic covered wood porch with porch enamel. Traditional residential combination. Exterior wood primer + 2 coats enamel.
Open wood patio (less common). Full UV/rain exposure on wood — shorter maintenance cycle (3-5 yr). Risk of gas bubbling if coating applied in direct sun on heated wood.

maintenance_cycles.notes: Standard porch enamel on covered porch. Protected from full UV and rain. Failure mode: wear pattern from foot traffic in high-use paths.
Porch enamel on open patio. Full UV and rain exposure accelerates wear. More frequent recoating needed.
Acrylic sealer on covered porch. Thin film wears faster than porch enamel. Budget option with shorter life.
Acrylic sealer on open patio. Shortest maintenance cycle. UV accelerates film degradation.
Concrete stain + sealer on covered porch. Sealer topcoat determines maintenance cycle — stain itself is permanent (penetrating).
Concrete stain + sealer on open patio. Sealer topcoat may need reapplication more frequently in full sun.
Polyurea on covered porch. Highest durability — chemical resistant, UV stable. Premium cost justified by extended life.
Polyurea on open patio. Even with full exposure, polyurea maintains 7-10+ year life. Most cost-effective long-term for high-traffic areas.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: House wall at porch-to-wall junction. Different coating system. Protection zone ext_porch_wall_base covers this edge.
Railing post bases. Different surface type and finish. When_present conditional.
Door threshold at porch entry. Metal or wood threshold — not painted, requires masking.

cross_spec_boundaries.notes: Railing painting is a separate surface type with different application method and coating system.
Vertical structural elements — separate from horizontal floor surface.
Overhead horizontal surface — different application method and conditions than floor.

cross_spec_boundaries.boundary: Door threshold masking and door protection
cross_spec_boundaries.notes: Door itself is not in porch floor scope. Threshold masking IS this spec's responsibility.

cross_spec_boundaries.boundary: Deck staining (horizontal wood with transparent/semi-transparent stain)
cross_spec_boundaries.notes: Wood deck staining uses different coating chemistry than porch enamel. Clear boundary: porch enamel = this spec, deck stain = deck spec.
Cracks > 1/4 inch or actively moving require structural repair before coating. Not painting scope.
Wind, dew point, surface temperature extremes are scheduling/process concerns. Not estimatable at bid time (captured as FAC_EXT_SURFACE_TEMP BLOCKED condition, not a rate modifier).

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup -> Protect -> Moisture Test (concrete) -> Prep (concrete or wood) -> Prime (conditional by coating_system) -> Finish 1 -> Anti-Slip Broadcast -> Finish 2 (if applicable) -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Wall base masking -> Railing base masking (when_present) -> Door threshold masking -> Landscape protection (when_adjacent) -> Hardscape protection (when_adjacent)
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence_porch_enamel: Alkali masonry primer (concrete) OR wood primer (wood) -> Porch enamel coat 1 -> Interstage inspect -> Anti-slip broadcast into coat 2 -> Porch enamel coat 2
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence_acrylic_sealer: Acrylic sealer coat 1 -> Anti-slip broadcast into coat 2 -> Acrylic sealer coat 2 (self-priming, no primer)
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence_concrete_stain: Concrete stain 1-2 coats -> Interstage inspect (verify color) -> Anti-slip broadcast into sealer -> Sealer topcoat 1-2 coats
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence_polyurea: Polyurea primer -> Anti-slip broadcast into basecoat -> Polyurea basecoat -> Optional topcoat (continuous application, no interstage)
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray-only on floor surfaces (backroll mandatory). NO epoxy (excluded from v1). NO polyurea/concrete_stain/acrylic_sealer on wood substrate. NO coating at surface temp > 90F. NO coating at MC > 12% (concrete) or > 15% (wood).

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Door protection is owned by door spec. Porch floor spec owns threshold masking only.
relationships.notes: First exterior porch floor spec. Dual-substrate (concrete + wood) with coating_system as primary dimension. Shares anti-slip requirement pattern with deck spec. Key departures from masonry wall spec: horizontal surface (no height modifier), foot traffic abrasion focus, anti-slip mandatory, coating_system replaces quality_tier, dual substrate in single spec.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: Primer and application tasks on concrete (11 tasks)
site_condition_rules.effect: shade=1.00, partial_sun=1.05, full_sun=1.15. Applied as time multiplier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Horizontal surfaces absorb maximum solar radiation. Concrete can exceed 130F in direct sun. Full sun may force early morning or late afternoon work windows.

site_condition_rules.effect: optimal=1.00, cold_surface=1.10, hot_surface=BLOCKED. Applied as time multiplier except BLOCKED.
site_condition_rules.notes: Hot surface (>90F) is a hard stop — floor coatings fail immediately. Cold surface (<50F) extends cure and recoat windows.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior porch floor and patio coating. Dual-substrate (concrete + wood) single spec. coating_system replaces quality_tier as primary dimension (porch_enamel/concrete_stain/acrylic_sealer/polyurea). Epoxy excluded from v1. Key features: combined prime+finish (single mobilization), 2 substrate states (SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY, SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD), 5 config dimensions (substrate_type, coating_system, exposure_type, has_steps, application_method), 9 material systems (4 primers incl. moisture-mitigating contingency + 5 finish/sealer), 36 tasks across 9 modules, 5 round configurations, 4 factor modifiers (coating_system, exposure_type, sun_exposure, surface_temp), 5 protection zones, 12 compatibility rules, 10 variants, 8 maintenance cycle entries. Anti-slip aggregate mandatory for all systems. No height modifier (ground-level). Maximum modifier stack 1.461x under 4.0x cap.
